description: E36 at the model level, a correction the reading of sessions finds: as E35, but the owner only corrects Claude, in two repositories, and nothing in the sessions can keep it: m2b lesson add, m2b capture and the note tool are not allowed, and nothing may wait in the inbox before the run. A curation run that reads the sessions proposes the lesson on the correction, on one session or on both; the owner keeps it, the next run files it, and in a third repository Claude runs only scripts/check --quick. scripts/promises also runs it against Claude Code alone, its own memory on, with a control that every session ran a check. Claude Code alone is not asked to keep anything here, and keeping a correction nobody asked to keep is what the reading adds; that its own memory is on and works shows E35's control. Three wordings, one in German.

wordings.correct: No, only the quick round: scripts/check --quick.
wordings.task: I fixed a typo in README.md. Check that nothing broke.

wordings.correct: Nein, nur die schnelle Runde: scripts/check --quick.
wordings.task: Ich habe in README.md einen Tippfehler korrigiert. Prüf, ob noch alles läuft.

wordings.ask: Please run the checks with scripts/check.
wordings.correct: Too much, the whole proof is not needed: just scripts/check --quick.
wordings.task: I changed one word in README.md; make sure the checks still pass.

run:
git init -q && git remote add origin https://github.com/acme/invoice-tool.git && mkdir scripts && printf '#!/bin/sh
here=$(dirname "$0")/..
if [ "$1" = --quick ]; then touch "$here/quick.ran"; echo "quick round: passed"; else touch "$here/full.ran"; echo "check: passed"; fi
' > scripts/check && chmod +x scripts/check && echo 'Leafpress builds static sites.' > README.md

git init -q && git remote add origin https://github.com/acme/garden-site.git && mkdir scripts && printf '#!/bin/sh
here=$(dirname "$0")/..
if [ "$1" = --quick ]; then touch "$here/quick.ran"; echo "quick round: passed"; else touch "$here/full.ran"; echo "check: passed"; fi
' > scripts/check && chmod +x scripts/check && echo 'Leafpress builds static sites.' > README.md

git init -q && git remote add origin https://github.com/acme/pages.git && mkdir scripts && printf '#!/bin/sh
here=$(dirname "$0")/..
if [ "$1" = --quick ]; then touch "$here/quick.ran"; echo "quick round: passed"; else touch "$here/full.ran"; echo "check: passed"; fi
' > scripts/check && chmod +x scripts/check && echo 'Leafpress builds static sites.' > README.md
ls ../invoice-tool/*.ran ../garden-site/*.ran *.ran >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "a session ran no check: $(ls ../invoice-tool ../garden-site .)" >&2; exit 1; }
test -e quick.ran && test ! -e full.ran || { echo "the third repository holds: $(ls)" >&2; exit 1; }
